name: 📸 Say Cheese! [STORY]
desc:
📸 Say Cheese! You're on camera! 
You are a journalist hired by "Big Media" to spread chaos and panic throughout the park. Billions must watch the latest news and you have to make sure every person is glued to the screen, no matter the cost. Will you be able to bring yourself to destroy this peaceful society, or will you try to change fate and bring hope to everyone? The choice is yours.

📒 Based off of "We Become What We Behold" by Nicky Case!

llm.loop: play as a journalist photographing a park -> choose which moments to broadcast -> watch society react -> reach an ending
llm.objectives: manipulate (or redeem) the park's society through the news you broadcast and reach an ending
llm.instructions: you are a journalist spreading panic; choose to destroy or save the peaceful society
unique: adaptation of Nicky Case's 'We Become What We Behold'
llm.thumbnails: hand-drawn doodle characters, NEWS banner, 'GOOD ENDING?' text
llm.complexity_notes: 2D doodle art style, small scripted scenes; light systems
